  echo       = TRUE,
  message    = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  comment    = "#>",

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)    # dplyr, tidyr, stringr, forcats, tibble, ggplot2
library(lmerTest)     # linear mixed models with Satterthwaite p-values
library(broom.mixed)  # tidy() for merMod objects
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

```{r}
# dataframes of interest
id_musical_unpruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/musical_attribution/id_attribution_bootstrap_results_long.csv')%>%
  filter(Signature=='ID18')%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, mean_exposure)
colnames(id_musical_unpruned)<-c("Sample",'ID18Musical_unpruned')

id_musical_pruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/musical_attribution/id_attribution_bootstrap_results_long.csv')%>%
  filter(Signature=='ID18')%>%
  mutate(mean_exposure=ifelse(CI_low==0,0,mean_exposure))%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, mean_exposure)
colnames(id_musical_pruned)<-c("Sample",'ID18Musical_pruned')

id_musical<-left_join(id_musical_pruned,id_musical_unpruned,'Sample')

sbs_musical_unpruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/musical_attribution/sbs_attribution_bootstrap_results_long.csv')%>%
  filter(Signature=='SBS88')%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, mean_exposure)
colnames(sbs_musical_unpruned)<-c("Sample",'SBS88Musical_unpruned')

sbs_musical_pruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/musical_attribution//sbs_attribution_bootstrap_results_long.csv')%>%
  filter(Signature=='SBS88')%>%
  mutate(mean_exposure=ifelse(CI_low==0,0,mean_exposure))%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, mean_exposure)
colnames(sbs_musical_pruned)<-c("Sample",'SBS88Musical_pruned')
sbs_musical<-left_join(sbs_musical_pruned,sbs_musical_unpruned,by='Sample')
musical_attribution<-left_join(sbs_musical,id_musical,'Sample')
# pruned MSA
sbs_msa_pruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/msa_sbs_attribution/pruned_attribution_paediatric_crypts_SBS_abs_mutations.csv')%>%
  dplyr::select(X,SBS88)
id_msa_pruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/msa_id_attribution/pruned_attribution_paediatric_indel_crypts_ID_abs_mutations.csv')%>%
  dplyr::select(X,ID18)
msa_pruned_attribution<-left_join(sbs_msa_pruned,id_msa_pruned,'X')
colnames(msa_pruned_attribution)<-c('Sample','SBS88MSA_pruned','ID18MSA_pruned')

# unpruned MSA
sbs_msa_unpruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/msa_sbs_attribution/output_paediatric_crypts_SBS_weights_table.csv')%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample,SBS88)
id_msa_unpruned<-read.csv('../Signatures/msa_id_attribution/output_paediatric_indel_crypts_ID_weights_table.csv')%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample,ID18)
msa_unpruned_attribution<-left_join(sbs_msa_unpruned,id_msa_unpruned,'Sample')
colnames(msa_unpruned_attribution)<-c('Sample','SBS88MSA_unpruned','ID18MSA_unpruned')
msa_attribution<-left_join(msa_pruned_attribution,msa_unpruned_attribution,'Sample')

# sigprofiler crypts
sbs_sigprofiler_pruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/sigprofiler_bootstrapped/sbs_attribution_signature_confidence_intervals.tsv')%>%
  filter(signatures=='SBS88')%>%
  mutate(mean_attribution=ifelse(lower_95_CI==0,0,mean_attribution))%>%
  dplyr::select(sequenceid, mean_attribution)
colnames(sbs_sigprofiler_pruned)<-c("Sample",'SBS88Sigprofiler_pruned')

id_sigprofiler_pruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/sigprofiler_bootstrapped/id_attribution_signature_confidence_intervals.tsv')%>%
  filter(signatures=='ID18')%>%
  mutate(mean_attribution=ifelse(lower_95_CI==0,0,mean_attribution))%>%
  dplyr::select(sequenceid, mean_attribution)
colnames(id_sigprofiler_pruned)<-c("Sample",'ID18Sigprofiler_pruned')
sigprofiler_pruned<-left_join(sbs_sigprofiler_pruned,id_sigprofiler_pruned,'Sample')

sbs_sigprofiler_unpruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/sigprofiler_bootstrapped/sbs_attribution_signature_confidence_intervals.tsv')%>%
  filter(signatures=='SBS88')%>%
  dplyr::select(sequenceid, mean_attribution)
colnames(sbs_sigprofiler_unpruned)<-c("Sample",'SBS88Sigprofiler_unpruned')

id_sigprofiler_unpruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/sigprofiler_bootstrapped/id_attribution_signature_confidence_intervals.tsv')%>%
  filter(signatures=='ID18')%>%
  dplyr::select(sequenceid, mean_attribution)
colnames(id_sigprofiler_unpruned)<-c("Sample",'ID18Sigprofiler_unpruned')
sigprofiler_unpruned<-left_join(sbs_sigprofiler_unpruned,id_sigprofiler_unpruned,'Sample')

sbs_sigprofiler<-left_join(sigprofiler_pruned,sigprofiler_unpruned,'Sample')

# mmmsig :
sbs_mmsig_pruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/mmsig_attribution/mmsig_sbs_bootstrap_ci.txt')%>%
  filter(signature=='SBS88')%>%
  mutate(estimate=ifelse(CI025==0,0,estimate))%>%
  dplyr::select(sample, estimate)
colnames(sbs_mmsig_pruned)<-c("Sample",'SBS88mmsig_pruned')

sbs_mmsig_unpruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/mmsig_attribution/mmsig_sbs_bootstrap_ci.txt')%>%
  filter(signature=='SBS88')%>%
  dplyr::select(sample, estimate)
colnames(sbs_mmsig_unpruned)<-c("Sample",'SBS88mmsig_unpruned')
sbsmmsig<-left_join(sbs_mmsig_pruned,sbs_mmsig_unpruned,'Sample')

id_mmsig_pruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/mmsig_attribution/mmsig_indel_bootstrap.txt')%>%
  filter(signature=='ID18')%>%
  mutate(estimate=ifelse(CI025==0,0,estimate))%>%
  dplyr::select(sample, estimate)
colnames(id_mmsig_pruned)<-c("Sample",'ID18mmsig_pruned')

id_mmsig_unpruned<-read.delim('../Signatures/mmsig_attribution/mmsig_indel_bootstrap.txt')%>%
  filter(signature=='ID18')%>%
  dplyr::select(sample, estimate)
colnames(id_mmsig_unpruned)<-c("Sample",'ID18mmsig_unpruned')
idmmsig<-left_join(id_mmsig_pruned,id_mmsig_unpruned,'Sample')

mmsig<-left_join(sbsmmsig,idmmsig,by='Sample')


## sigfit :
sigfit_attribution<-readRDS('../Signatures/sigfit_attribution/sigfit_attribution.rds')
sigfit_mean<-sigfit_attribution$mean%>%rownames_to_column(var='sample')%>%pivot_longer(cols=contains('SBS'),names_to='signature',values_to='mean')

sigfit_lower_ci<-sigfit_attribution$lower_95%>%rownames_to_column(var='sample')%>%pivot_longer(cols=contains('SBS'),names_to='signature',values_to='lower_ci')
sigfit_upper_ci<-sigfit_attribution$upper_95%>%rownames_to_column(var='sample')%>%pivot_longer(cols=contains('SBS'),names_to='signature',values_to='upper_ci')
sigfit_compiled<-left_join(sigfit_mean,sigfit_lower_ci,c('sample','signature'))%>%
  left_join(sigfit_upper_ci,c('sample','signature'))%>%
  mutate(mean=ifelse(lower_ci<0.01,0,mean),
         donor=str_extract(sample,'PD\\d{5}'))%>%
  filter(signature=='SBS88')%>%
  dplyr::select(sample, mean)
colnames(sigfit_compiled)<-c('Sample','SBS88_sigfit')


attribution_compiled<-left_join(msa_attribution,musical_attribution,'Sample')%>%
  left_join(sbs_sigprofiler,'Sample')%>%
  left_join(mmsig,by='Sample')%>%
  left_join(sigfit_compiled,by='Sample')

## annotate at a per biopsy and per patient level:
attribution_compiled$patient=str_extract(attribution_compiled$Sample,'PD\\d{5}')

# assess each 
attribution_patient_compiled<-attribution_compiled%>%
  group_by(patient)%>%
  summarise(across(contains(c('MSA','Musical','Sigprofiler','mmsig','sigfit')),~case_when(sum(.x>0)>1~2,
                                                          sum(.x>0)==1~1,
                                                          
                                                          TRUE~0)))%>%
  column_to_rownames('patient')

attribution_patient_compiled_mt<-as.matrix(attribution_patient_compiled)
colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt)<-str_replace_all(colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt),'(?<=1|8)8','8 ')
colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt)<-str_replace_all(colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt),'_pruned','\n[Pruned]')
colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt)<-str_replace_all(colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt),'_unpruned','\n[Not pruned]')
colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt)<-str_replace_all(colnames(attribution_patient_compiled_mt),'_sigfit',' Sigfit')

col_fun <- c("0" = "grey95", "1" = "hotpink3", "2" = "maroon4")

svglite::svglite("../Supplementary_Figures/supplementary_figure_3_signature_attribution.svg", width = 16, height = 8)

ht <- Heatmap(
  t(attribution_patient_compiled_mt),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  col = col_fun,
  row_split = rep(1:ceiling(nrow(t(attribution_patient_compiled_mt)) / 4), each = 4)[1:nrow(t(attribution_patient_compiled_mt))],
  row_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Signature attribution", at = c("0", "1", "2"), labels = c(
      "Not Detected",
      "SBS88 / ID18 detected in 1 crypt",
      "SBS88 / ID18 detected in > 1 crypt"),
    direction = "horizontal",
    nrow = 1
  )
)

draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", annotation_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()

attribution_patient_compiled%>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(),~sum(.x>1)/90))

attribution_patient_compiled%>%
  filter(SBS88Musical_pruned>0 & ID18Musical_pruned>0)%>%
  nrow()
```
